basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old tech enthusiast and history buff based in Austin, Texas. I work as a software developer during the day and enjoy exploring historical weaponry and online gaming in my free time. I'm currently single and often spend late evenings browsing Reddit after work. I dislike misinformation and try to stay informed about current affairs. On weekends, I like to unwind by playing Black Desert Mobile.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas, I've spent the past decade honing my skills in software development. My interest in history, particularly military history, is a result of self-study and online courses. I often share insights and engage in discussions about these topics on Reddit.
